profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hands-on, humble, self-motivated, and seasoned banking engineer with 10+ years developing professional web/mobile/backend applications and managing engineering teams. Spent the last 7 years focusing on banking infrastructure and operations for the financial services company CapWay, which includes developing software to support payment processing, compliance, remote deposit capture, and various consumer and business banking products. 

Nothing makes me happier than using new technology to solve problems with social impacts. I have an immense love for building large scale systems. At the moment, I predominantly spend my time building distributed networks that serve a variety of use cases. I'm highly proficient at using CSS3/SASS to making pixel exact designs, deploying and architecting highly scalable applications on Kubernetes, and building large iOS applications.

[Highly Active on Github]
https://github.com/dondreytaylor

positions.title: Platform Engineer (Cybersecurity)
positions.description: As application developer lead in the Cybersecurity division of Georgia Tech's Office of IT, I lead the design and implementation of IAM platform and policies, ensuring secure access to academic and administrative systems while supporting the university's compliance standards including the Department of Defence’s CMMC compliance. Collaborated with academic and research computing teams to develop and optimize infrastructure components, fostering a reliable and high-performance computing environment for faculty and students. Successfully implemented automation tools and scripts for infrastructure provisioning, enhancing the efficiency of system deployment and updates. Worked closely with university security teams to enhance IAM controls, contributing to the continuous improvement of the overall security posture.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineering Instructor
positions.description:
As Full Stack Engineering Instructor at Rutgers University's Bootcamp through edX/2U, I have the privilege of teaching and guiding aspiring developers on their journey to becoming proficient and versatile tech professionals. Through hands-on projects and lectures, I teach the latest web technologies, including HTML5, CSS3, SASS, JavaScript (ES6+), and responsive web design, among other programming concepts and topics such as object-oriented programming, Node, MySQL, etc.

Moreover, my curriculum covers the entire Full Stack, from front-end to back-end development. I guide students in mastering popular front-end frameworks like React and Vue.js, enabling them to create dynamic and interactive user interfaces. In my class I unpack the complexities of server-side programming, instructing students in Node.js and Express.js to build scalable and robust back-end systems. Additionally, I introduce them to relational databases like MySQL and PostgreSQL, along with NoSQL databases like MongoDB.Students learn to design and implement RESTful APIs, establishing seamless communication between front-end and back-end components. I emphasize the importance of version control using Git, empowering students to collaborate efficiently on projects and manage code effectively.

Beyond technical skills, I instill in students a growth mindset and a passion for continuous learning. I encourage them to explore emerging technologies, best practices, and industry trends, ensuring they remain adaptable and relevant in their careers.As an instructor, I provide personalized mentorship to each student, fostering a supportive and inclusive learning environment.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · CSS · Web Development · HTML · Node.js

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
As principal engineer, I'm responsible for developing internal tools and platforms to support various iLEX teams and clients such as different small to mid-size banks and fintechs. Oversee and assist clients with their development needs, including integrations with various network associations like Visa and MasterCard network, payment processors, KYC/AML vendors, issuing/acquiring bank APIs, etc.

Worked directly with CISO and director of information security to ensure that iLEX and its clients remain in compliance with PCI, SOC 2, GBLA, etc
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Banking · Terraform

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
positions.description:
Developed and managed CapWay’s banking ios/android and react/angular based web/mobile applications while also serving as Chief of Banking Operations. Created and implemented a multi-cloud banking infrastructure for CapWay’s debit card and savings account product consisting of 20+ Kubernetes nodes and 100+ dockerized Node and Python microservices spanning a multi region multi availability zone Tailscale mesh network within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Compute (GCE) clouds. In addition to being hands-on when it comes to development, I was also responsible for managing development and technical operations of all engineering teams and coordinated with different product owners to create technical specifications.. Created and implemented a GitOps or IaC (Infrastructure as Code) strategy that allowed CapWay to provision cloud resources via Kubernetes Operator (kOps) and Terraform scripts creating an environment capable of handling 20M+ daily API calls, 50M+ yearly card transactions, and have a 99.999% SLA uptime in production. Configured three stage automated deployment flow to move code from sandbox, to UAT/client validation, and into production with proper code tests/reviews, and validations.

Coordinated with compliance and consumer banking departments to ensure that CapWay’s technical direction aligned with and kept up with all upcoming products, and any regulatory compliance and security risks. Designed APIs that could be consumed by various partners and product teams. The APIs developed utilized JWE tokens and OAuth to validate access. Used Grafana/prometheus and CloudWatch to monitor clusters/infrastructure states.

As CTO and the principal project manager, I regularly ensured that software development life cycle (SDLC) was adhered to in accordance with the company information technology policies. Frequently tested disaster recovery and business continuity plans as well as conducted PEN tests against CapWay’s on-prem and cloud networks.

positions.title: Chief of Banking Operations (COO)
positions.description: Oversaw all of CapWay’s banking operations while also being CTO. Facilitated all communications and integrations with vendors such as Visa, Mastercard, Fiserv, NACHA, and multiple issuing and acquiring banks. I assisted CapWay’s compliance officer with bank audits (including preparing responses to regulatory oversight bodies such as cfpb, occ, federal reserve, etc). Worked directly with the CEO and other core team members to increase deposit volume by $5M+. Created fraud mitigation technology to help stop $20M+ of ACH fraud. Actively monitored NACHA and chargeback/dispute rates. Worked through the process of obtaining PCI DSS merchant level 1 compliance by reporting to an external auditor to go through field test and remediation, to secure an attestation of compliance. Monitored and analyzed all money movement on the platform for money laundering and suspicious transactions using custom in-house transaction mapping, alerting, and visualization tools. Integrated the ability for CapWay to process AFT (account funding transactions) and OCT (originating credit transactions) with a Visa Direct partner that provided a way for CapWay users to link and utilize external bank cards similar to Venmo/PayPal, CashApp,etc.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer + PM
positions.description:
As principal engineer I was responsible for building out the first iteration of CapWay’s consumer banking products with the following stacks: NodeJS/MongoDB based backend, React with HTML5, SASS, TypeScript, and an iOS Swift based app.

Created a custom deployment pipeline using Argo, Tekton, and Jenkins to allow for rolling backend and frontend deployments that minimized and in most cases eliminated downtime between updates into Kubernetes. Worked with DBAs to come up with data schemas as well as map out data ingress and egress involving CapWay’s sharded Mongo cluster and Cassandra card transaction datastore. Used Kafka and Redis to coordinate inter-microservice communication of at least 100+ Node microservices.

Created self-hosted private docker registry and NPM package repository to handle company images and packages. Leveraged AWS’s S3 and Glacier products to handle long term and short term backups of application data and cluster states.

positions.title: Founder / Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Created a payments hardware/chipset that can store various digital currencies and act as a payment gateway for merchants that accept different currencies as payment. In addition to developing the chipset, I also developed an iOS application and a responsive web application to control the chip via low energy bluetooth.

I managed a team of 5 engineers and was able to get NimbleNode to yearly sales of $300k. Ensured that the team followed agile and SDLC principles. Regularly tested out disaster recovery and business continuity plans. Monitored and analyzed production and UAT environments daily - https://github.com/nimblenode

Highlights/Technologies Used:
● SASS, HTML5, TypeScript to create adaptive designed site to manage accounts
● Used Figma to create designs
● AWS’s Elastic Container Service contained containerized Node microservices for
the backend, and used to accept socket connections from nimbleNode devices.
● Redis configured as replica cluster and used to keep track of device states
● Mongo replica cluster used for logging and account storage
● Used Bash and C programming to develop the merchant digital currency payment
processing interface.
● Used AWS lambda to create functions integrated with Twilio and SendGrid for the
notification system.
positions.insights: Skills: ACH Payments · React.js · MERN Stack

positions.title: Founder / Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with and managed a team of 15+ engineers to develop payments and mining software for open and closed digital currency ASIC and GPU mining rigs. The software I worked on included a responsive web interface for managing the rigs, code that operated at the OS level to facilitate the mining algorithm like equihash, and infrastructure split between Google Compute (GCP) and AWS for pooling rigs together and facilitating payments to operators. I was successfully able to scale pool software to support ~$1M USD monthly in total payouts and 1000+ mining rigs connected.

Highlights/Technologies Used:
● Designed frontend using Sketch.
● Created the entire frontend using React in TypeScript with SASS to handle order
intakes and manage mining rigs remotely.
● Backend of BTC Innovations was configured within two private clouds situated in
Google Compute (GCE) and Amazon Web Services (AWS) provisioned using Kops
(Kubernetes Operator) and Terraform.
● Used Hashicorp Vault to store keys of connected mining rigs
● Logs stored in CloudTrails and notifications were coordinated to different SQS
queues and Kafka in addition to CloudWatch.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · MERN Stack · Node.js · Bash · C (Programming Language)

positions.title: Founder / Principal iOS Engineer (Talk Video)
positions.description: Tack is an iOS collaborative video application I created that allows users to add videos to a story that could be streamed to followers in real time. Implemented Apple’s HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) on Nginx Media Servers while also building out a transcoding pipeline using AWS’s media encoder. At peak, Tack processed about 1000 hours daily of video. Created front landing page using Angular, TypeScript, and SASS/CSS3.

positions.title: Founder / Principal iOS Engineer
positions.description: MiniChat Inc is an iOS mobile app company I founded focusing on topical chat rooms that I created using objective-c and swift. The backend of MiniChat I developed in NodeJS and leverages RTC and web sockets with Redis to keep track of user messages and rooms. Backend of MiniChat was configured to use AWS’s Elastic Beanstalk with a set of network load balancers with sticky sessions to ensure chats were handled by the same set of servers. Created front landing page using React, TypeScript, and SASS/CSS3. At its peak, MiniChat handled 500k daily messages

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer + PM
positions.description:
I had the opportunity to work with a small team of Panasonic North America engineers for my Capstone at NJIT, to develop a critical health care platform to monitor various vital signs of senior citizens. The platform is real time, makes use of low energy bluetooth devices that emitted signals through Panasonic's distributed relay network- EMIT, combined with Redis caching. 

As the project lead, I oversaw and contributed to the design and implementation of the health care platform, and acted as the liaison between Panasonic and the undergrad team that I lead.

Highlights/Technologies Used:
● Configured healthcare portal to operate as a docker image using docker compose
running on 10 AWS EC2 instances.
● Leveraged AWS’s Route53 to round robin DNS between front facing application
load balancers
● Developed the frontend using Angular in TypeScript, along with HTML5 and SASS.
● Designed interface using Photoshop
● Using low energy bluetooth protocol, I created code that sent vital sign signals
from pulse oximeter to beaglebone black hardware
● Developed API using Node/JavaScript that interfaced with Panasonic’s relay
network.
● Leveraged Redis to track device online/offline state and message replays.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Voice Recognition Service company. Developed a complete redesign of multiple text-to-speech audio products including Talkz celebrity voice changer and iSpeechs’ core text-to-speech product. Worked on backend APIs that connected to a convolutional neural network to train speech synthesis models that were used to to translate text for a variety of customers.

Highlights/Technologies Used:
● AngularJS, SASS/CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript, and REST APIs for retrieving
text-to-speech audio.
● Used MySQL to store information about voice stickers and user account details.
● Used File API and web workers to perform in browser audio processing and
playback.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Résumé Builder Web/Mobile Application. Designed and developed a highly scalable web and mobile based résumé builder using Backbone.js and eventually migrating to AngularJS. Built Purzue’s backend using PHP with a MySQL replica set as the datastore.

Worked with a team of developers to come up with a simplistic résumé builder that could be used by prospective jobseekers.

While working at Purzue, it was my job to translate the designs given by our design team into a useable cross-browser compatible interface. As our development team grew, I began to take on a bigger role in designing a more scalable backend, that could account for Purzue's growing user base of +500k.

The Purzue résumé builder focuses on intelligently guiding users through a series of questions about their education, employment, and background, which would then populate a custom and professional looking résumé layout. Unlike traditional résumé builders, Purzue's résumé builder continously notifies the users on ways to improve their résumé based on their linkedin and various other social media, while also taking into account industry changes.

Highlights/Technologies Used:
● HTML5 and SASS used to create frontend design.
● Used Backbone.js and eventually migrated the platform to AngularJS.
● Built Purzue’s backend using PHP with a sharded MySQL database.
● Setup On-Premise development environment using local servers
● Migrated production workload to the cloud provider Rackspace.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed various front end modules for Lafango, a talent website providing its users with an  electronic press kits creator. Built Lafango's backend using PHP and MySQL.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer / Head of IT
positions.description:
Developed advanced web and mobile-based HIPAA compliant prescription systems for managing prescription transfers, refills, and new requests. Managed and secured the pharmacy’s computer networks against cybersecurity threats and attack vectors on the local pharmacy network. Configured security camera network and sensors. Used Bash and Unix network programming.

Worked directly with the head pharmacist to construct a robust and secure network to handle all pharmacy activities. Key challenges included: Ensuring that the pharmacy network remained H.I.P.A.A. compliant,  coming up with various data safe guard and retention strategies, reducing/eliminating network attack vectors both local and remote, and  maintaining interoperability among terminals/network equipment.


Highlights/Technologies Used:
● Designed site and prescription fulfillment interface with Photoshop / Illustrator
● Went through H.I.P.A.A compliance checks ensuring that data retained and
processed by site and local Pharmacy network remained in compliance.
● Ensured site as ADA compliant and responsive
● Configured pharmacy network to act seamlessly with outside networks via VPN.
● Configured network device backups to on-prem and external storage facilities.

positions.title: Web Developer & Consultant
positions.description: Created a web development studio that did frequent web freelancing for a number of clients.. Through partnership with a design agency I had the opportunity of working on Muscle Maker Grill's website, and a few other high profile websites- among them a logistics company, designer clothing company, and local police department site. While most projects I developed using Vanilla JavaScript and a PHP backend in Laravel, there were a number of projects which required creating custom Wordpress templates and backends.

positions.title: Geek Squad Agent
positions.locationName: Woodbridge, New Jersey, United States · On-site
positions.description: Worked as a Geek Squad agent (also referred to as Counter Intelligence) for Best Buy. Performed various diagnostics on customers computers to determine hardware and software issues. Carried out repairs such as: laptop screen replacements, backups, keyboard replacements, hard drive/RAM upgrades, virus removal, and performance optimizations.

projects.title: Decentralized News Network (DNN)
projects.description:
Founded a collaborative news platform that leverages distributed networks and the public
to deliver radically transparent data-driven news content. DNN’s frontend was developed using TypeScript, Angular, and SASS. The backend of DNN is hosted on the Ethereum blockchain as smart contracts written in Solidity. Using the web3 JS library, I set up a complete interface for reviewers and contributors that gave them a way to interact with the main smart contract.

projects.title: Bitcore
projects.description: Contributed to a number of repos that were derivatives of Bitcore. My contributions included creating a blockchain explorer for viewing different Bitcoin forks, as well as a block explorer that allows you to convert a Bitcoin block into its different components (e.g. headers, body, root Merkle hash, Input TXOs, Output TXOs, etc).

publications.title: Decentralized News Network - News by the people, for the people.
